notes.title: UPDATE v1.53
notes.content:
Quick fix of launch problem / internet connection on certain Windows configurations.
Added small improvements during driving and braking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278960/4ccc1be36300c4853d15af0506de54742a320186.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.9
notes.content:
- Added destructible objects on the road like: wood logs, metal junk, gates, tin shed, planks, chain link gates and fence, telephone poles and wooden barriers. Smash them all:)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fk7BcvcjxlM

- Improved car steering, (you can adjust steering using STEERING SENSITIVITY slider in MAIN MENU->OPTIONS->CONTROLS).

- Added BRAKE SENSITIVITY slider to control effectiveness of the brake.

- Fixed camera jitter.

- Improved light on various scenes.

- Improved and more optimized reflections on the cars.

- Linux: added option to launch game using 64 bit version.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.8
notes.content:
- Improved car steering plus better grip to the road.
- Fixed problem with stopping car during longer turn.
- Fixed hood camera view.
- Fixed handbrake.
- Improved car suspension.
- Added new and more dynamic soundtrack (Soundtrack 4).

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.7
notes.content:
- New car physics, new suspension, tires friction changed (sliding with high speed).
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rD507Eww-9A
- Added support for Logitech Wheels like G25, G27, G29 and other.
- Added support for controllers which previously were not detected by binding system.
- Fixed physics of objects on the road like barrels, cardboard box etc. Smooth animation when object is hit by a car.
- Improved binding system (while waiting for new button or axis, navigation in menu is disabled for 3 seconds until system detects new axis or button).
- Improved car engine sound.
- Added better sound when car is taking a bend.
- Better car maneuvering on reverse gear (improved steer angle).
- Added clock illumination when turbo is held in cockpit view.
- Linux: fixed "black screen" at start.
- Linux: added option to launch game with Vulkan (add "-force-vulkan" parameter).
- Corrected Spanish language version.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.6
notes.content:
Improved car suspension.

Added new parameter (Terrain Optimization) in MAIN MENU->OPTIONS->GRAPHICS, for better performance (from 20% to 50% more FPS when set to HIGH).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33278960/ff520a0293206852e12b56d969c50070bab99d84.jpg[/img]

Fixed camera movements (smooth follow).

Improved camera when turbo is pressed.

Added small graphic improvements in environments (mainly in the forest).

Added more dust from car wheels:)

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.5
notes.content:
Fixed issue with gas and brake pedal on some wheels.

Improved overall "sense" of speed and dynamics while driving.

Better field of view of the camera.

Soundtrack played alternately on each race (optional).

Fixed issue with small frame drop when car was passing under the bridge.

notes.title: Free Demo
notes.content:
Free demo is now available.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33278960/ae0ae786608c142b3e8e90cd8052128191af089d.jpg[/img]

Demo limitations:
- one car
- one racetrack
- one type of race
- no bots
- multiplayer off
- career mode off

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4.4
notes.content:
Full controller support - new binding system allows to configure any type of game controller (Wheel, Gamepad, Joystick etc).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33278960/acadf640bf2702006258cd708a8a0ba4b5fe1ff8.jpg[/img]
